role: Declares FitnessSummaryCards, a non-View @MainActor struct holding the post-workout summary's session, track, units, collector, savedRouteStore, settingsManager and 25 bindings to FitnessPostSummaryView state, plus the nested ReportShareState. Its view-building methods live in other files; it is constructed in FitnessPostSummaryView+SummaryForwarding.swift.
types: FitnessSummaryCards: struct (@MainActor) — state carrier for export/recap/route-save/reanalysis/elevation-resmooth/PDF summary cards
FitnessSummaryCards.ReportShareState: struct — PDF presented URL (kept apart from the pdfURL cache), cache generation, and the PDF/recap render error
toplevel: Only stored-property declarations (lets and @Binding vars) and the ReportShareState struct with defaulted fields; no units, no logic. The doc comment describes the two dozen bound pieces of state by group.
